summary: 15,770 new FMCSA carrier registrations added to the USDOT system between 2026-04-04 and 2026-05-03 (last 30 days). Covers all 50 states. 99.8% phone fill rate, 99.9% email fill rate. Sourced directly from the DOT public data portal Company Census File — no auth required, no scraping. Texas (1,817), California (1,646), and Florida (1,284) lead by volume. 98.3% of carriers are active status (A). Includes USDOT number, legal name, full physical address, phone, email, carrier operation type, fleet size, and per-carrier SAFER source URL.
source_brief: FMCSA Company Census File via DOT Open Data Portal (data.transportation.gov/resource/az4n-8mr2). Public dataset updated daily, no authentication required. Data is sourced from FMCSA MCMIS (Motor Carrier Management Information System). Authority: FMCSA Data Dissemination Program — data shared at no charge per federal open data policy.
known_gaps: MC/FF docket number and authority grant date are not directly available in the Company Census File; those fields (docket1prefix, docket1, docket1_status_code) were absent in the returned data — steward may want to enrich using the Licensing and Insurance dataset (data.transportation.gov/resource/jeyh-5nsj) joined on dot_number. The 'add_date' field represents date the entity was added to MCMIS, which closely correlates with initial authority grant but may lag 1–3 days. Cargo type codes (carship) are single-letter codes (C=property, B=passengers, I=interstate, F=freight forwarder) rather than free-text descriptions. Fleet size (fleetsize) is encoded as A=0–6, B=7–20, C=21–100, D=101–500, E=501+ vehicles.
